- Need predictable billing and vendor onboarding for pilot (Q4).
- Security asks: SOC 2 summary + vendor questionnaire; finance wants standard PO flow if possible.

1) Payment method preference: PO (Net 30/45) vs corporate card — which does EverGrowth require for new vendors?
2) Vendor onboarding: do you need a filled questionnaire + W-9 and SOC 2 artifact before a vendor record is created?
3) Marketplace: any interest in using AWS Marketplace billing for the pilot (reduces AP load) or is that blocked by policy?

What I can send you now (attached):
- Redwood PO template (pdf) — we can populate your PO fields and return signed
- High-level SOC 2 summary (pdf)
- Example quote and mutual action plan (pdf)

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- You: confirm whether PO (and Net terms) required and share procurement contact / PO template if available
- Redwood: populate PO template or send DocuSign-ready PO + return SOC 2 summary + W-9
- Procurement: create vendor record and issue PO; Redwood to invoice against PO or bill via marketplace if approved

If you prefer, we can do DocuSign for the PO to speed vendor setup, or we can accept invoices to a billing email (accounts.pay@redwood.com) once vendor record is created.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our onboarding lead to help with the questionnaire and any technical evidence.

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side:

- EverGrowth requires a PO for new vendors; standard term is Net 45 (we can discuss Net 30 if needed).
- We do require a completed vendor questionnaire and a W-9 on file before finance will pay.
- Unfortunately our security policy prohibits third-party marketplace billing for core vendor spend (so AWS Marketplace is a no-go for this engagement).

I've looped in our procurement team (procurement.evg@evergrowth.com) to pick up the vendor setup. They will send our vendor onboarding template and GL code mapping. Please provide:
1) Redwood’s W-9 (or applicable tax form)
2) SOC 2 summary / audit contact
3) Filled vendor questionnaire (I'll attach in a reply)

Procurement note (copied): we typically need vendor remit address, tax ID, and a sample invoice format so AP can set up automated routing.

Thanks — Lucy
Lucy Chen
